name: uefn-entitlement-manager
description: Project-scoped In-Island Transactions and Verse entitlement manager for UEFN creators

scripts.build: node scripts/build-flag-sprite.mjs && tsc && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/fileService.test.ts tests/generator.test.ts tests/server-security.test.ts tests/textureImporter.test.ts tests/ui-regressions.test.ts tests/workflowClient.test.ts
scripts.test:desktop: dotnet publish desktop/UEFNEntitlementManager.Desktop.csproj -c Release --no-restore --output desktop/bin/Release/net48/publish && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-standalone-project-link.ps1
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:python && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:version
